fusions.name: Reef on a Rope
fusions.desc: Strings a rope 6 tiles long ahead of you and a jagged reef grows along it for 6 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it, knocks it back 2 tiles and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Holdfast Snag
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and snags it on anchoring strands, slowing it by 15% for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Anchored Colony
fusions.desc: After a 1 second cast, anchors a colony on a strand where you stand for 15 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles and deals 5 damage, with a 25% chance to leave the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Byssus Footing

riders.text: you move 10% faster over it than over ground
and your health regenerates 15% faster while you are on it
and your dodge chance is 8% higher while you are on it

fusions.desc: Anchoring strands hold you to the surface: you walk on water and swamp as on solid ground. While you are on water or swamp, from bronze rank you move 10% faster, from silver your health regenerates 15% faster, and from gold your dodge chance rises by 8%.
